> **2026-06-20 — ORCH-1171 [consumer-app keyboard "Done" bar + zero input-field occlusion] REGISTERED (INTAKE).** S2 / `ux`+`missing-feature`. **Reporter:** Seth (2026-06-20). Consumer sibling of the shipped business work [[ORCH-1170]] (was tracked as "ORCH-1170 Leg B"; now its own issue). **Affected Surfaces:** consumer iOS (`app-mobile`), consumer Android (`app-mobile`). **Surfaces explicitly NOT in scope:** buyer/anon Web + Admin Web + Business Web preview (browsers supply their own keyboard/dismiss — no custom accessory bar), business iOS/Android (already shipped via ORCH-1170). Backend: none — pure client UI + a native build.
>
> **The ask — TWO hard acceptance criteria, BOTH required (Seth, explicit):**
> 1. **The bar exists** — a slim **Done-only** keyboard accessory bar (brand-themed Done) sits on top of the keyboard on EVERY consumer text-input surface; tapping Done dismisses the keyboard. Parity with the business app's `KeyboardToolbar` (Done-only, `showArrows={false}`).
> 2. **The keyboard blocks NO input field — anywhere.** On every consumer input surface, with the keyboard (now ~42pt taller because of the bar) open, the focused field is fully visible above the bar — never occluded. This is the load-bearing criterion and the reason for the deep sweep below.
>
> **Definition of done = ON-DEVICE PROOF, not "mounted in source" (hard lesson from ORCH-1170):** every input surface enumerated in the sweep must be driven on BOTH an iOS simulator AND the physical Samsung, with before/after screenshots, proving (1) the bar appears and (2) no field is occluded. A surface verified only in source code is NOT done. **Android New-Architecture keyboard insets cannot be triggered by synthetic/automated taps → the final visual on each surface requires a real-finger pass (Samsung + a Seth eyeball on the surfaces automation can't stage).**
>
> **MANDATORY PRECONDITION before any code (Seth-directed):** a DEEP every-surface blast-radius sweep — enumerate EVERY consumer input surface (the ~17 real `<TextInput`-rendering components today: chat/message input, search/filter bars, onboarding steps incl. OTP, group-chat sheet, intake form, profile/connections, board discussion — verify the live count, it changes), classify each by its current keyboard-avoidance mechanism, and drive the iOS sim + Samsung into ALL of them to capture the BEFORE state. No implementation until the full at-risk inventory is proven (the business leg's "6 at-risk" list was wrong twice — do not repeat).
>
> **Technical reality + hard requirements (carry into SPEC):**
> - `app-mobile` has NO `react-native-keyboard-controller` and NO `KeyboardProvider` root; keyboard avoidance is bespoke (`app-mobile/src/components/ui/KeyboardAwareScrollView.tsx` = RN ScrollView + custom `useKeyboard` + `measureInWindow`). Adopt the library + a `KeyboardProvider` root (mirror business `KeyboardRoot.native.tsx` in `app/_layout`).
> - **Per-window providers (the ORCH-1170 SC-4 lesson):** EVERY RN `Modal` / bottom-sheet that hosts inputs needs its OWN `<KeyboardProvider>` — the root provider does NOT reach into a separate native window, so the bar is silently absent there. Sweep app-mobile for ALL Modal/sheet input hosts and give each its own provider.
> - **Bottom-anchored composers** (chat/message input) must be lifted by their `onLayout`-MEASURED height (+ breath), NOT a flat constant (a flat +bar-height only clears the composer's bottom edge, leaving the text row hidden — cost 2 FAILs on business).
> - `keyboardVerticalOffset` is an **Android no-op** when `KeyboardAvoidingView` `behavior` is undefined → use Android-aware padding keyed on keyboard-open.
> - **Delivery = a fresh NATIVE build, NOT OTA** (the library is a native module). The consumer iOS build will FAIL at pod install unless the **COMMS-0031 Google-pods modular-headers plugin is first ported into `app-mobile/plugins/`** + registered in `app-mobile/app.config.*` (DISC-1129-A) — land that BEFORE cutting the consumer iOS build.
> - Keep it library-only (no bespoke `Keyboard.addListener`-for-layout); the consumer app has no `orch-0892` gate today — consider extending the invariant to `app-mobile`.
>
> STATUS: REGISTERED, NOT started. Pipeline when dispatched: deep INVESTIGATE/blast-radius sweep (forensics, sim + Samsung) → SPEC (full at-risk inventory + per-Modal providers + the plugin-port dependency) → IMPLEMENT → native build → on-device TEST across every surface (iOS sim + Samsung + Seth finger-tap) → CLOSE. See [[project_orch_1170_keyboard_done_bar]] for the reusable keyboard facts.

Migrations `20261015000000_orch_1167_event_city_geo.sql` + `20261015000001_orch_1167_pg_public_event_by_slug.sql` applied to prod + recorded in `schema_migrations`; `pg_public_event_by_slug` live-smoke-verified. 5 `I-PROPOSED-1167-*` invariants ACTIVE; ORCH-0978 web-video gate updated to accept the imperative-DOM autoplay form (DEC-189). **Open follow-ons (registered, NOT bugs/not started):** D-1 publish-time `city_geo` centroid (map currently always NULL → honest empty); Phase 2 dissolve `@mingla/event-rendering` into `@mingla/offering-rendering` (~88 sites); the 3 sibling META-ORCH-1166 legs. > **2026-06-11 — ORCH-1113 [curated-experience-empty-deck-regression] CLOSED ✅ PASS.** S2 / `bug` + `regression`. **Affected Surfaces:** Consumer iOS + Android (app-mobile + shared Supabase edge fns); buyer-web/business/admin NOT in scope (no curated deck). **Symptom:** curated multi-stop "intent card" decks (Romantic / First-Date / Group-Fun / Adventurous / Picnic / Stroll) returned "No spots match right now" for remote/custom locations (Brussels reproducer) despite ample matching supply, while single cards rendered fine. **Root cause (PROVEN, v4 — source + live-DB backed):** the curated open-hours filter evaluated each stop's open/closed status against the STORED `datetime_pref` (a fixed timestamp that can be weeks stale) instead of the live clock, and NEVER read the user's `date_option` (Now/Today/This Weekend/Pick a Date). A stale instant read as afternoon in Raleigh (venues open → deck worked) but late-night in Brussels (venues closed → every vibe's required stop dropped → whole deck emptied), independent of the user's real clock or date selection. Single cards were immune only because the singles path uses the live device clock (`discover-cards` `new Date()`) and branches on `date_option`. The empty result was mislabeled with a hardcoded `pool_empty` reason. **Regressed-by:** ORCH-1061 (PR #329, `cd1437816`), which turned on the curated open-hours hard-drop; the `date_option`-blindness pre-existed but was inert before that hard-drop. **DISPROVEN:** region-gating / supply-starvation — `fetch_local_signal_ranked` has no city/country/region gate and returns ample Brussels supply (investigation E-2/A). **Fix:** new shared `resolveCuratedHoursPolicy` helper — `today`/`now` → evaluate against the LIVE clock (parity with single-card `filterByDateTime`); `this_weekend` → open-at-ANY-hour on Sat or Sun; `pick_dates` → open-at-any-hour on the selected day(s); unknown → safe live-clock default (never trust the stale pref). Threaded `date_option` + `selected_dates` from the RN client through BOTH the solo (`generate-curated-experiences`) and collab (`discover-cards`) curated paths. Replaced the hardcoded `pool_empty` with a distinct `all_closed_at_time` reason ONLY when cards existed pre-filter and were all hours-dropped (genuine empty pools keep `pool_empty`); extended the `CuratedEmptyReason` union, aggregated it in `deckService.ts`, threaded the reason to `SwipeableCards`, and branched the consumer empty-state copy ("Everything's closed right now"). **NO SQL / RPC / migration change.** ORCH-1061's same-day "don't serve a closed venue right now" intent + Constitution #9 honest-unknown (no-hours venues assume open) preserved. **Files:** `supabase/functions/_shared/curatedStopHours.ts`, `supabase/functions/generate-curated-experiences/index.ts`, `supabase/functions/discover-cards/index.ts`, `app-mobile/src/services/deckService.ts`, `app-mobile/src/services/curatedExperiencesService.ts`, `app-mobile/src/types/curatedExperience.ts`, `app-mobile/src/contexts/RecommendationsContext.tsx`, `app-mobile/src/components/SwipeableCards.tsx`, + i18n `cards.json` (32 locales) + tests. **Regression tests (fails-on-revert verified):** implementor happy-path T-01 in `supabase/functions/_shared/__tests__/curatedStopHours.test.ts` (Brussels +120 policy-only; fails at `b87804932`); tester adversarial (6 tests, different angles) in `supabase/functions/_shared/__tests__/curatedStopHours.adversarial.test.ts` (T-3-01 Tokyo +540 end-to-end filter; fails-on-revert at `cb9ccf1a1`). Executed test runs green: shared module 25/25, generate-curated 35/35, discover-cards 89/89, businessHours 17/17. **New invariant I-PROPOSED-CURATED-HONORS-DATE-OPTION flipped ACTIVE.** **Status: CLOSED PASS.** **Two open follow-ups (separate, NOT this ORCH, both logged in OPEN_INVESTIGATIONS, neither closed here):** (1) `run-signal-scorer` throwing 500s on fresh-venue scoring; (2) pre-existing CI gate `orch-0910-chat-payload-curated-aware` fails identically on `origin/main` (unrelated to this fix). Evidence: spec/impl/test/investigation under `Mingla_Artifacts/{specs,reports,investigations}/*ORCH-1113*`. Full close banner in WORLD_MAP.

> **2026-05-20 — ORCH-0895 [Marketing Composer V2 — Bold / Italic / Underline buttons + Cmd+U shortcut broken on web] REGISTERED + CLOSED PASS Grade A — single-session INVESTIGATE → IMPLEMENT → TEST → CLOSE on `Seth` by Claude orchestrator.** Plain-English impact: in the marketing composer (`/marketing/blast/compose` on `mingla-business` web), tapping Bold / Italic / Underline pills did nothing; tapping Link did nothing; Cmd+B and Cmd+I worked (Tiptap StarterKit binds them) but Cmd+U did nothing. **Two root causes:** (1) a prior turn rewrote the B/I/U/Link toolbar handlers in `ComposerV2Editor.tsx` from `sendAction(actions.X, "result")` to `commandDOM(focusExecJs("X"))`. (b) Reverted `ComposerV2Editor.tsx` toolbar handlers (both imperative handle + local) from `commandDOM(focusExecJs(...))` to `sendAction(actions.setBold|setItalic|setUnderline, "result")` — routes correctly on web Tiptap AND iOS/Android pell. > **2026-05-17 — ORCH-0857 [Hub Events filter pill row "weird space on top"] CLOSED PASS Grade A — Hub → Events list now sits flush against the filter pill row across all five filters (All / Live / Upcoming / Drafts / Past).** Plain-English impact: tapping Live or Drafts no longer pushes the event cards ~150pt down the screen with a big empty gap above them. Original investigation + spec diagnosed it as a border-alpha perceptual illusion (border swap shipped as Edit 1); operator-reported "weird space STILL exists" after that fix forced a re-investigation via iOS sim live-fire that identified the actual root cause. **Actual root cause:** React Native's `<ScrollView>` outer container defaults to `flexGrow: 1` + `flexShrink: 1`. The Hub Events host contained TWO ScrollView siblings (the horizontal `pillsScroll` filter pills + the vertical events ScrollView event list) competing for the host's leftover vertical space; when the events list was short (Live=2, Drafts=0 → empty card), pills greedily took 150-200pt extra and rendered empty space below the pill content inside its stretched frame, pushing the events list down. Fix (Edit 4 — the actual bug fix): pin `pillsScroll` with `flexGrow: 0` + `flexShrink: 0` so it takes only its 50pt intrinsic height regardless of how much leftover space is available. Three operator-approved bonus polish edits also folded in: pill border alpha raised 0.08 → 0.55 white (toggle changes color only, never bounding rect — Edit 1 cosmetic), Pressable `hitSlop={top:5, bottom:5}` for WCAG AA / I-38 44pt touch target (Edit 2 a11y), `pillLabel.lineHeight: 16` locks Live-pill dot/label baseline (Edit 3 polish). **Pipeline:** Claude `mingla-orchestrator` INTAKE → Claude `mingla-forensics` INVESTIGATE (border-alpha hypothesis — wrong) → Claude `mingla-forensics` SPEC (locked wrong fix) → Claude `mingla-implementor` IMPLEMENT (3 cosmetic edits shipped, bug not addressed) → operator "the space STILL exists" → Claude `mingla-implementor` RE-DIAGNOSE via iOS sim live-fire on iPhone 17 Pro (UDID `17091E60-C3B6-4167-980D-60C348E177F6`) → Edit 4 root-cause fix shipped → Claude `mingla-orchestrator` TEST inline (TARGETED sub-mode 10-step protocol, tester adversarial check authored attacking 5 different angles than implementor happy-path) → PASS verdict P0:0 P1:0 P2:0 P3:0 P4:1 → CLOSE this entry. **ORCH-0840 [Regression-test enforcement + append-only CI] Step 0.5 satisfied:** implementor happy-path `mingla-business/scripts/ci/orch-0857-pill-visual-parity-check.mjs` 10/10 PASS with fails-on-revert verified at parent `a2019cfd5155eceaafaddebe38dc9cd31ece311c` (true-line-deletion of `flexGrow: 0` + `flexShrink: 0` from pillsScroll flips E4.a + E4.b to FAIL, exit 1); tester adversarial `mingla-business/scripts/ci/orch-0857-tester-adversarial-check.mjs` 6/6 PASS attacking different angles (TA1 asymmetric pinning - events ScrollView must NOT have flexGrow:0, TA2 hit-target math 34+5+5=44, TA3 alpha-parity invariant I-PROPOSED-PILL-ACTIVE-STATE-VISUAL-PARITY delta ≤0.10, TA4 global-token isolation guard, TA5 ScrollView-count sanity forces re-audit when count changes). DIAG reap clean (zero `[ORCH-0857-DIAG]` markers). **NEW MEMORY CODIFIED (high-leverage for future sessions):** `feedback_rn_scrollview_flex_grow_default_one_silent_footgun.md` warns that two `<ScrollView>` siblings in a flex parent silently compete for space (RN default `flexGrow:1`) producing content-size-dependent gap bugs that look like state-specific issues. > **2026-05-17 — ORCH-0858 [Vercel `.vercelignore` project-aware split] REGISTERED + CLOSED CONDITIONAL PASS, BACKFILL-EXEMPT (deploy-config + documentation only, no product code touched) — single repo-root `.vercelignore` was shared across three Vercel projects and listed `mingla-marketing/` as ignored, stripping the marketing Next.js source on every cacheless deploy.** Type: architecture-flaw + documentation-drift. Severity: was S2 (intermittent — cacheless builds only) but exposed as S0-during-merge by PR #122 because branch protection's required-check list includes `Vercel – mingla-marketing` so the cacheless failure blocked the ORCH-0852 [Bulletproof buyer checkout] + ORCH-0854 [Consumer ticket status live-flip valid→used on scan] bundle merge. Surface: backend/deploy-infra — no client surface (no end-user impact, only blocks PR merges + reliable deploys). Discovery: PR #122 cacheless build log via `vercel inspect dpl_92P81WV6r8xkvCjTpkfT2XgAmAhN --logs` showed `Removed 3117 ignored files defined in .vercelignore` followed by `No Next.js version detected. Make sure your package.json has "next" in either "dependencies" or "devDependencies"`. **Root cause:** repo-root `.vercelignore` line 7 listed `mingla-marketing/` as ignored to keep `mingla-business`'s upload under Vercel's 10MB request-body limit; the same file is read by all three Vercel projects regardless of Root Directory setting, so the marketing project's own deploy stripped its own source. Cached deploys hid the bug (Vercel reused prior build state); cacheless deploys (cold cache, new PR branch) exposed it. **Fix:** (1) slimmed repo-root `/.vercelignore` to universal exclusions only — `node_modules/`, `app-mobile/`, `backend/`, `oauth-redirect/`, `scripts/`, `supabase/`, `tests/`, `Mingla_Artifacts/`, `Mingla_Roadmap/` — and the header comment explicitly FORBIDS any subfolder of `mingla-admin/`, `mingla-business/`, `mingla-marketing/`; (2) created per-project `.vercelignore` files at `mingla-admin/.vercelignore`, `mingla-business/.vercelignore`, `mingla-marketing/.vercelignore` covering only own internal cruft (`node_modules`, `.env`, `.next/`, `dist/`, etc.); (3) authored runbook `docs/runbooks/VERCEL_VERCELIGNORE_ARCHITECTURE.md` documenting the architecture, day-to-day "which file to edit when" rules, verification steps, symptom-to-cause cheat-sheet, and history. **Pipeline:** INTAKE (orchestrator surfaced from PR #122 Vercel check failure) → INVESTIGATE (orchestrator inline — Vercel CLI inspect log) → IMPLEMENT (orchestrator direct, 5 file changes: 1 root .vercelignore rewrite + 3 new per-project files + 1 new runbook) → CLOSE (this entry). Affected Surfaces: backend-only — deploy-infra config + documentation; no client surface. Working tree: `/Users/sethogieva/Desktop/mingla-main` on branch `Seth`. **Bundled into PR #122 as operator-authorized expansion** (PR title updated to include ORCH-0858) because the fix structurally unblocks the same PR's merge — atomic shipping is the right boundary; no separate PR per `feedback_one_pr_per_close.md` narrow exception. **Operator follow-up recommended:** verify in Vercel dashboard that each of the three projects has Root Directory set to its own subfolder (`mingla-admin`, `mingla-business`, `mingla-marketing`); the per-project `.vercelignore` files are read only when Root Directory is configured. If Root Directory is unset on any project, that project's deploy still falls back to the repo-root file and the protection works as long as the root file no longer lists the project's own folder. **Verification deferred to next post-merge cacheless deploy** — the canonical regression-prevention proof requires a Vercel rebuild without cache; passing on PR #122's next push (or a manual "Redeploy with cache disabled") confirms the fix. **Evidence:** root `/.vercelignore` (slimmed), three new per-project `.vercelignore` files, runbook at `docs/runbooks/VERCEL_VERCELIGNORE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.

> **2026-05-12 - ORCH-0811 REGISTERED + CLOSED PASS (S0 hotfix, same-day) — Ticket Pay button non-2xx regression (Stripe `customer_update` incompatible with `customer_email`).** Type: regression + invariant-violation (Constitution #3 No silent failures — buyers saw a generic "edge function error" instead of an actionable message; the strict-grep gate that was meant to enforce ORCH-0804's contract instead enshrined the broken parameter shape). Severity: S0-critical — every ticket purchase flow in production was down from ORCH-0804 close (2026-05-12 10:12 EDT, commit `95d2061a`) until orchestrator deploy (2026-05-12 ~15:13 EDT). Surface: `supabase/functions/ticket-checkout-create/index.ts` web Checkout Session path. **Root cause:** ORCH-0804 added `customer_update: { address: "auto" }` alongside the existing `customer_email: buyerEmail` to satisfy what was believed to be a Stripe Tax jurisdiction-lookup requirement. Stripe's actual API contract: `customer_update` is only valid alongside an existing `customer` id (returning customers); when paired with `customer_email` (which spawns a fresh Customer per buyer), Stripe rejects every `checkout.sessions.create` call with `"You cannot use customer_update without setting customer"`. Stripe Checkout already auto-collects the buyer billing address on the new Customer when `automatic_tax.enabled=true`, so the parameter was never functionally needed for tax. ORCH-0804 tester PASS was code-forensic + mock-based and never exercised the live Stripe call — third documented instance of the `headless-QA-RPC-gap` pattern (after ORCH-0540 plpgsql wrappers and ORCH-0776D notification dispatcher). **Closed fixes (orchestrator direct execution, operator delegated):** (1) `supabase/functions/ticket-checkout-create/index.ts` — removed the `customer_update` block at lines 237-244; replaced with rationale comment citing ORCH-0811 + the exact Stripe error string; `automatic_tax` + `liability.account=stripeAccountId` retained intact (ORCH-0804 Stripe Tax invariant I-PROPOSED-BF preserved end-to-end). (2) `.github/scripts/strict-grep/orch-0804-stripe-tax-enabled-on-checkout.mjs` — inverted Check 3 from "must contain `customer_update: { address: \"auto\" }`" to "must NOT contain `customer_update:` in active code lines" (comments stripped before scan via line-prefix `//`/`*` filter). Different error than v3's Deno `Invalid URL`. The Supabase/Cloudflare edge proxy has a smaller URL cap than Deno fetch (~10-12KB vs ~64KB). To stay under that cap we'd need ~200-ID chunks → 25 sequential roundtrips per intent → ~2s overhead. **Pivoting to architectural fix: RPC push-down.** Write a Postgres RPC `fetch_local_signal_ranked(filter_signal, filter_min, rank_signal, lat_min, lat_max, lng_min, lng_max, required_types, limit)` that does the entire bbox+filter+rank query server-side in ONE call, returns top-N place_ids + scores. No `.in()` over thousands of IDs — IN happens inside Postgres where no URL constraint exists. Total roundtrips: 2 (RPC + Step 3 hydrate) instead of 5-15 chunked. v3.2 = 1 new migration + ~20 LOC code refactor. Pure architectural improvement — also fastest design. > **ORCH-0539 (NEW 2026-04-19 15:29 UTC — P3 security-hygiene, non-blocking):** `admin_get_feature_flags(TEXT[])` SECURITY DEFINER function was GRANTed EXECUTE to `authenticated` but PUBLIC default EXECUTE was not REVOKEd. Both `anon` and `authenticated` roles have EXECUTE privilege. **No actual vulnerability today** — the function's internal `admin_users WHERE email = lower(auth.email()) AND status = 'active'` gate fails for anon callers (NULL auth.email() → EXISTS check returns false → RAISE EXCEPTION). Defense-in-depth suggests narrower surface. **Fix (single-line migration):** `REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.admin_get_feature_flags(TEXT[]) FROM PUBLIC;`. Bundle into future admin RPC hardening pass. Discovered during ORCH-0526 M4.2 tester MCP probe. Classification: security + architecture-flaw. S3 (low priority). Investigator rescanned per Forensic Thoroughness Rules, found the real mechanism, and amended the report. **Corrected RC-1': Dual-source divergence.** Two components check "am I in a session?" from DIFFERENT state sources. (a) `SwipeableCards.isBoardSession` depends on `resolvedSessionId` which is derived from `availableSessions` coming from the `useSessionManagement()` hook (network-backed, lags on cold-launch / just-created session / just-accepted invite) — see [SwipeableCards.tsx:550-570](../app-mobile/src/components/SwipeableCards.tsx#L550-L570). (b) `AppHandlers.handleSaveCard.isInSession` reads `stateRef.current.boardsSessions` from the Zustand global store (updates immediately via `setBoardsSessions`) — see [AppHandlers.tsx:681-694](../app-mobile/src/components/AppHandlers.tsx#L681-L694). When (a) lags while (b) is fresh: `isBoardSession = false` so the primary swipe gesture takes the solo branch at [SwipeableCards.tsx:1499](../app-mobile/src/components/SwipeableCards.tsx#L1499) → calls `onCardLike(card)` → `handleSaveCard` sees session via (b) → direct `INSERT INTO board_saved_cards` via `BoardCardService.saveCardToBoard` (bypasses `check_mutual_like` trigger which only fires on `board_user_swipe_states` writes). Simultaneously `trackSwipeState` at [:1538](../app-mobile/src/components/SwipeableCards.tsx#L1538) is skipped (also gated by `isBoardSession`). Net: saved-card row exists, ZERO swipe-state rows. **DB proof:** session `3f1fa200` has 1 `board_saved_cards` row for user `c727d491` on Assaggio's (2026-04-19 05:41:59) and 0 `board_user_swipe_states` rows from that user in that session. That pattern is mechanically impossible under any other code path. Also confirmed: `check_mutual_like_trigger` is correctly installed (was not the culprit); `bsc_insert` RLS allows user-context direct inserts (defense-in-depth gap = ORCH-0535); 6 total anomaly rows in production data. **Original RC-1 demoted to CF-0** (real co-existing leak — 3 unguarded `onCardLike` callsites at SwipeableCards.tsx:1633, :1885, :2417 — still needs closing). **Option D recommended fix:** make `handleSaveCard` solo-only (remove collab branch lines 766-874), unify "am I in a session?" source of truth, route all collab saves exclusively through `BoardCardService.trackSwipeState` → trigger. This single change eliminates BOTH RC-1' AND CF-0 structurally. **2 new invariants:** I-SESSION-STATE-SINGLE-SOURCE, I-HANDLE-SAVE-CARD-IS-SOLO-ONLY. Lesson logged in report §16.8: "when two functions gate on 'same' state, verify they read from the same source, not just that both have a check." > **ORCH-0531 (NEW 2026-04-19 evening — known limitation, deferred):** Rule rollback (admin_rules_rollback RPC) creates a new rule_set_version matching the target version, but does NOT auto-restore prior AI verdicts on places affected by the rolled-back rule. Concrete scenario: AI accepts Bar Vento → rules-v8 rejects Bar Vento (overwrites place_pool.ai_approved=false) → admin rolls back to v7 → re-runs rules-filter → rules don't fire on Bar Vento (no rule rejects it) → place_pool.ai_approved STAYS at false (last-writer-wins). Bar Vento doesn't reappear in decks. v1 mitigations: (a) history preserved in ai_validation_results so admin can SEE the AI verdict that got overwritten, (b) admin can manually override via Review Queue (existing admin_ai_override_place RPC), (c) re-running AI validation on affected places restores verdicts (costs OpenAI tokens), (d) impact preview before save (spec §5.2) makes the bad-rule-save scenario rare. v2 fix options: snapshot last_ai_verdict on place_pool OR compute on-the-fly from ai_validation_results history. ~2-3 days build. Classification: missing-feature + ux. S3 (low — has manual mitigation, low frequency expected). Discovered via user product question on ORCH-0526 Phase 3 spec review.
